About Us

My 36-Year Spiritual Journey - Still Continuing...

From cable television to spiritual media around 35–36 years ago, I began my journey in Tamil Nadu as a cable television operator. At that time, the television industry was growing rapidly. With the knowledge and experience I had in the field, I developed the idea that cable television should not be used only for entertainment, but also as a medium to reach people with advertisements and business information. Based on this idea, I was one of the early pioneers in Tamil Nadu to take the initiative of broadcasting local advertisements through cable television. I took advertisements to people across various parts of Tamil Nadu, including major roads and cities. For this purpose, I appointed advertising agents and took complete responsibility for obtaining advertisements, coordinating them, and broadcasting them through cable television. During that period, the television industry developed very rapidly. Later, television companies such as Raj TV and Sun TV grew and brought various programmes, including live broadcasts, to people. At the same time, I continued my work in the field. Over time, my work and interests gradually turned towards spirituality and temple-related media activities. One of the most important turning points in my life was a live event at the Tiruchendur Subramaniya Swamy Temple. From an important event that took place during the live programme at Tiruchendur Temple to the moments when Annadhanam began during the Palani Thaipoosam festival, this journey has been filled with numerous spiritual experiences. Following that, my spiritual journey continued across various sacred places in Tamil Nadu, including Rameswaram Aadi Amavasai, Anaimalai Masani Amman Temple Amavasai worship, and Bannari Amman Temple. This journey also extended beyond India. In Malaysia, I had the opportunity to visit and broadcast from several sacred temples, including the Batu Caves Murugan Temple, Thannermalai Temple, and Kallumalai Temple. Through the series “Ambu Aalayangal” on Zee Tamil television, I brought these spiritual destinations to audiences across the world. Following this, my spiritual journey continued in various places in Indonesia, including the Jakarta Varahan Temple, Medan Muthukumara Swamy Temple, and the Indiran Temple in Bali. In Sri Lanka as well, I had the opportunity to broadcast from sacred places such as the Nallur Murugan Temple and Nuwara Eliya, which is associated with Sita. In this way, my journey has taken me from Tamil Nadu through various parts of India and across countries such as Malaysia, Indonesia, and Sri Lanka. Along the way, I have gathered countless spiritual experiences involving temples, festivals, Annadhanam, Amavasai worship, and many other sacred traditions. This is my adventurous 36-year journey through life. This is not just a journey. It is a spiritual quest that has become a part of my life. 36 years have passed. But my journey has not yet come to an end. There are still many more sacred places. And many more experiences to come.

A Pioneer in Spiritual Broadcasting

Malligai Advertisement Agency made history by being the first to bring the traditional Soorasamharam celebration to television through a live telecast, connecting this sacred spiritual event with audiences beyond the temple and reaching homes through television.

Our Services

What We Offer

From spiritual events to broadcast advertising, our services carry devotion, culture, and creativity to the people who need them.

  1. 01

    Spiritual & Dosha Parihara Events

    We promote spiritual events and traditional Hindu remedial ceremonies for people seeking spiritual solutions for life situations such as delayed marriage. These events may include special poojas, homams, temple rituals, and other traditional parihara practices based on spiritual beliefs.

    "Embracing Faith. Guiding Souls. Honouring Traditions."
  2. 02

    Global Culture & Spiritual Live Coverage

    We travel across countries to explore and document the diverse cultures, traditions, spiritual practices, festivals, and lifestyles of people from different religious and cultural communities. Through professional video production and live broadcasting, we bring authentic experiences and cultural stories directly to audiences worldwide.

    "Exploring Cultures. Connecting Communities. Broadcasting Stories."
  3. 03

    Annadanam Sponsorship

    We help devotees sponsor Annadanam at temples and spiritual places on their behalf. When they are unable to personally visit and organize Annadanam, we coordinate with participating temples to arrange food distribution in their name. This allows devotees to contribute to traditional acts of service and share the blessings of Annadanam from wherever they are.

    "Sponsoring with Faith. Serving with Love. Sharing Blessings."
  4. 04

    Cable TV Advertising

    Malligai Advertisement Agency provides television advertising solutions through local cable TV networks, helping businesses and organizations reach audiences directly in their communities. With our experience in cable television advertising, we have been among the early pioneers in bringing advertisements to cable TV, creating a strong foundation for our advertising journey.

    "Reaching Audiences. Building Brands. Creating Impact."
